scope: Fixed-budget comparison of estimators of the same complete-transition residence response; not independent validation of endpoint prediction accuracy or physical-cluster calibration

reporting.bootstrap_scope: Empirical percentile intervals with Bonferroni component levels across six ratios; resample independently within each insertion stratum. Approximate descriptive uncertainty, not finite-sample coverage or protection against unseen rare scores.
reporting.variance_metric: Equivalent score variance n*Var(estimated mean). Stratified mean variance is sum_s w_s^2 sample_variance_s/n_s; ordinary pooled sample variance is not used for stratified uncertainty.
reporting.cost_metric: Var(estimated mean) multiplied by total process CPU seconds; lower is better. CPU includes trajectory calculation and cache access, excludes setup/postprocessing; measured timing is conditional on machine/cache/load and is not itself assigned a confidence interval.
reporting.diagnostics: Per-block and pooled means, score extrema and tails, signed stratum contributions, branch-reward covariance, numerical continuation allowances, stops, wall/CPU times and cache loads/builds. No score clipping.
reporting.decision: Recommend an estimator for a new independently sampled response test only if the fixed pilot shows reproducible variance/cost improvement with intact marginal-law controls. This pilot does not reuse earlier endpoint validation to declare response accuracy.
reporting.adaptation: No sample-size or threshold changes after outcomes; all 36 jobs retained even if differences are inconclusive. Methods not selected from observed mean/sign.
reporting.mean_reporting: Nine response means and six independent-arm differences with descriptive standard errors only; no confidence-based equivalence claim. Algebra and controls establish the identical expectation target.
reporting.budget: Equal quartet counts, not equal CPU budgets; variance is primary and observed CPU-adjusted efficiency is descriptive.
